brief:
A young man from Gaza saw his aspirations to study abroad and build a life beyond the territory derailed by the ongoing conflict, We Are Not Numbers reported. The war has forced him to abandon plans that represented escape and opportunity from life in Gaza.

His story reflects the broader impact of the conflict on Palestinians' futures, as many young people have had educational and professional prospects disrupted by displacement and instability. The war has halted the educational and career plans of an entire generation across the territory.
dek: A young man’s dream of studying abroad and experiencing life beyond Gaza is shattered by war.
title: War shatters young Gazan's dream of studying abroad
